subject: issue with Shiny & sankey D3 diagrams with rCharts

messages.author: 2ef256a129b97763
messages.subject: issue with Shiny & sankey D3 diagrams with rCharts
parts:
I produced a sankey diagram in shiny & rCharts.  Very nice. From right to left it has many levels, currently 3 (I've attached a generic sankey diagram to illustrate the problem).

With reference to the attached picture, suppose that item 3 stops at level 2 and does not go all the way to the next level.  The problem is that the sankey diagram "flattens" all the leaf levels to the "last level".
So if item 3 stop is represented as level 4. (in dimensional modelling language I would say that D3 does not support ragged hierarchies out-of-the-box).

With the mouse I can manually drag item 3 so that it can align to the other level 2 items, but next time I run the shiny application the item is again in its original position.

Ultimately I want to achieve a diagram like the second one (also visible here http://greencracker.net/?p=1685).

The green element referring to the 3,386 honors that passed at least one house is the interesting one.  If I would try to do this with shiny, rchart and D3, the green element would be aligned to the extreme right ones as the leaf of its branch, taking away meaning form the diagram.

How to solve this problem?

(please let me know if I should submit this query to the D3 guys as well). Thanks

Enzo
